nodes.summary: For every real square matrix $A$, vectors $b, x_0$ and step $k$, a $k$-th GMRES iterate exists. It is the solution of the least-squares problem $\min_c \|r_0 - A K_k c\|_2$.
nodes.title: Existence of GMRES iterates

nodes.summary: For a real $n \times n$ matrix $A$, a right-hand side $b$, an initial guess $x_0$ with residual $r_0 = b - Ax_0$ and a step $k$, a vector $x$ is a $k$-th GMRES iterate if $x - x_0 \in \mathcal{K}_k(A, r_0) = \operatorname{span}\{r_0, Ar_0, \dots, A^{k-1} r_0\}$ and $x$ minimizes $\|b - Ay\|_2$ over all $y \in x_0 + \mathcal{K}_k(A, r_0)$.
nodes.title: GMRES iterate

nodes.summary: The $n \times k$ Krylov matrix $K_k = [\,r \mid Ar \mid \cdots \mid A^{k-1} r\,]$.
nodes.title: Krylov matrix

nodes.summary: $v \in \mathcal{K}_k(A, r)$ if and only if $v = K_k c$ for some $c \in \mathbb{R}^k$.
nodes.title: The Krylov space is the column space of the Krylov matrix

nodes.summary: If $A$ is an invertible real $n \times n$ matrix, every $n$-th GMRES iterate solves $Ax = b$ exactly (in exact arithmetic).
nodes.title: Finite termination of GMRES

nodes.summary: If $x$ is a $k$-th GMRES iterate, then $\|b - Ax\|_2 \le \|p(A)\, r_0\|_2$ for every real polynomial $p$ of degree at most $k$ with $p(0) = 1$. Since the GMRES residual is itself of the form $p(A) r_0$ (not formalized here), GMRES solves the polynomial approximation problem "minimize $\|p(A) r_0\|$ over $p \in P_k$, $p(0) = 1$": its convergence is governed by how small a polynomial normalized at the origin can be…
nodes.title: The GMRES polynomial bound

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
